description: Create a new project. Every field is optional. Returns project_id for add-document-sources, write-artifact, and request-creation.

course_id.description: Positive integer course id from search-courses. Example: 1581710. The course is checked before the project is created; an unknown id creates nothing. Omit to leave the project unlinked.

emoji.description: Icon text, usually an emoji. Example: "📚". Omit to leave the icon unset.

title.description: Name, 1-255 characters, with at least one non-space character. Example: "Biology midterm". Omit to create the project without a name; the returned title is then "Untitled project".

name: create-project

project_id.description: UUID string in 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal form. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.

title.description: Agent-displayable project title. Null Alpha names become "Untitled project".

title: Create Studocu Project
